thread:
maria: quick heads-up — p99 for /v2/generate jumped from ~220ms to ~480ms in the latency dashboard at ~09:15 UTC. p50/p95 look unchanged. anyone touched sampling/rollup config? :eyes:

alex: saw that too. my first guess is we accidentally started mixing in admin/internal routes into the endpoint rollup. the breakdown shows an odd tag set.

jon: could also be a change in sampling weight — we switched to request-weighted sampling last week for a/b experiments. tails can get worse if we don’t normalize by tokens.

maria: interesting — i pulled the raw traces for a small slice and it does show a cluster of long decoder times coming from model-variant:lite-cost.

alex: posting the query i used to check the rollup aggregation:
```sql
-- fetch per-request durations and rollup sampling tags
SELECT route, sample_tag, approx_percentile(duration_ms, 0.99) as p99, count(*)
FROM telemetry.requests
WHERE ingested_at >= now() - interval '2 hours'
  AND route LIKE '/v2/%'
GROUP BY route, sample_tag
ORDER BY route, p99 DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

priya: if the lite-cost variant sneaks into the same route rollup it would inflate p99 but not affect p50/p95 much — matches symptoms. are routes annotated consistently at ingress? routing policy recently got a tweak to attach `route_v2` vs `route` labels.

jon: aha — we have two label keys now: `route` and `route_v2`. older rollup logic only looked at `route` and fell back to route_v2 in some code paths. new telemetry agent attaches both but sometimes as arrays, which broke our dedupe in the rollup reducer.

maria: great catch. so two suspects: (1) label dedupe bug, (2) sampling weight shift. which should we fix first?

tara: from product POV, customers saw the p99 blip in the console graphs. we should prioritize a quick fix to stop cross-route contamination (label dedupe). then rollout a sampling normalization patch. can we do a short canary for the label fix? :+1:

alex: i can throw a small patch to the rollup reducer to normalize labels to a single canonical `route` key before grouping. will add a unit test for array labels. plan: patch -> canary -> promote.

deploy-bot: deploy started: telemetry-rollup-normalize-labels v2024.09.23-rc1 by alex — canary to 10% of ingestion nodes.

jon: while that canary runs i'll run a backfill sim locally to estimate effect on p99. if it's purely contamination we should see p99 drop back to baseline in the next 10m.

priya: small UX ask: console should show an annotation when label-merge heuristics run (so users know we normalized). right now it looks like a silent correction and confuses folks. can we add a tooltip note?

maria: agreed. add an annotation on the endpoint breakdown panel: "Labels normalized: route / route_v2 merged" and link to docs.

alex: noted. i'll add the tooltip in the dashboard PR after the canary.

jon: canary results: reduced cross-route counts for /v2/generate by ~18% and p99 dropped from 480ms -> 230ms for canary shard. looks like dedupe was it.

maria: awesome — roll canary forward. also file a follow-up for sampling normalization so we don't get recurrence when we change weighting.

tara: i'll create a short incident note for customers who saw the spike and add the dashboard annotation to the rollout notes.

alex: rolling canary to 100% now. patch includes tests and a changelog entry.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: telemetry-rollup-normalize-labels v2024.09.23 (all nodes).

maria: closing loop — p99 back to baseline, will monitor for 24h. thanks everyone. :tada:
